T cells in the GCAA lesion are highly activated as judged by their expression of HLA- DR antigen and IL- 2 receptor.
the inflammatory process in GCA is characterized by a local accumulation of HLA- DR expressing T cells in the arterial wall.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the immune response in giant cell arteritis is characterized by a strong local activation of T lymphocytes in inflamed arteries.

the expression of HLA-Dr on T cells was significantly higher in GCA patients than in healthy controls and that the expression of IL-2R and HLA-Dr was significantly higher in the GCA patients with active disease than in those with inactive disease.
